title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans' Memorial Coliseum on 1981-05-12
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 1644
source: 3x Nakamichi CM-300 w/CP-1 cardioids > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XL-II 90's. Mics handheld, recorded from left side (stage right) first-level riser, about half way back

ai_review.summary: Audience recording captures an energetic show with great bass and slightly thin treble, making Brent’s keys sit back nicely.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as excellent and full of energy, highlighted by a strong low‑end from Phil’s bass. The audience (AUD) source sounds good overall but lacks some high‑frequency sparkle, which unintentionally tames Brent’s keyboard presence. It’s an enjoyable listen despite the modest treble roll‑off.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate (3‑star) review; reviewer praises the show but notes limited treble, leading to a modest overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear bass and overall energy, but noticeable lack of treble which reduces high‑frequency detail.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic performance with strong low‑end focus; no specific song commentary provided.

band_member_comments.Phil: Great bass presence noted and praised.
band_member_comments.Keys: Reduced treble makes Brent's keyboards less intrusive, which the reviewer found desirable.
